672.t: Jazz Profiles and the Peabody Award

367.t: Receiving the NEA Jazz Masters award in New York

367.t: What the NEA award means to a first trumpet player

367.q: Well, it was a great award, I mean, t o receive that I think it is, it‘s a nice honor to receive the National Endowment of the Arts Award. A lot of the guys all had to make speeches and different things, but I didn‘t because I had my problem and they talked to me, but I had somebody close by to…

367.s: Asked what to leave for listeners to the Smithsonian recording, Young says he is honored to be chosen.

But I just appreciate…I don‘t know…it‘s kind of tough for…

You should have had it years ago.' I said, 'Well, I don't know about that. I was too young to have it years ago.'…

114.s: He discusses the Hall of Fame and NEA Jazz Masters nominations and feeling lucky.

114.q: No, not particularly because, like, if -- if I'm awarded something, I appreciate it, but it depends on who gives it to me.

504.t: Receiving the NEA Jazz Masters award
504.s: He says it took time to sink in and is honored to be recognized.
504.q: Well it took me awhile for it to register, to believe I’d gotten it. Particularly the fact that it’s the last year it will be given out because of our financial atmosphere that we’re in right now. I really feel honored and it’s a really good feeling to be recognized for my passion, for what I love…

220.t: NEA Jazz Masters events and old friends Snooky Young and Gerald Wilson

651.t: 'Jazz is from America' and the end of the interview
651.s: The NEA award raises awareness of jazz, and the sign he shows kids saying jazz is from America.

So I’m hoping that maybe this advocacy award will allow people to think a little more about jazz. Because it’s from America.…
